visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair styled in a high bun, adorned with a pearl headband and a white scrunchie, is featured in a bright indoor-outdoor terrace. She is wearing a white off-the-shoulder mini dress with long, flared bell sleeves. She is seated among multiple gold-colored metallic banquet chairs, looking directly at the camera. She then leans forward, resting her chin on her arms which are draped over the back of a chair, and smiles softly. The setting is flooded with natural light coming through large glass panels that reveal green trees in the background. (2) The scene cuts to the woman standing near a large window overlooking a city skyline and an outdoor rooftop swimming pool. She is positioned with her side to the camera and slowly turns her head to look back over her shoulder with a neutral, slightly pouting expression. The bright sunlight creates high-contrast highlights on her shoulders and the white fabric of her dress. (3) The scene returns to her sitting among the gold chairs. She glances over her shoulder, touches her cheek with her hand, and then breaks into a wide, joyous smile while leaning against the chair back again. The background features a distant urban landscape and a clear sky seen through the glass architecture of the terrace.
